name: session-board
description: Desktop mod: a live board next to the session - a pyramid summary, an outline map, turns, decisions and open questions - plus a session ledger that Claude reads back after compaction.

update.title: When to update the map
update.description: every-turn: after each turn with real work (uses a fork of the session, read from cache). manual: only on /board-update.

minTools.title: Minimum tool calls per turn before the map updates
minTools.description: Turns with fewer tool calls skip the model call and only record the turn.

autoOpen.title: Open the board when the session starts
autoOpen.description: Open the board pane when an interactive session starts.

injectAfterCompact.title: Give Claude the ledger brief after compaction
injectAfterCompact.description: After compaction, append the ledger brief so Claude keeps decisions, constraints and dead ends.
